image_prompt: Night photo of the Taipei skyline with the Taipei 101 tower clearly visible on the left; far out at sea on the right horizon a huge nuclear fireball and mushroom cloud rises from the ocean, glowing bright orange and yellow, silhouettes of grey warships on the sea in front of it, the glow lighting the clouds and the city.

Close view from low orbit at dawn over the island of Taiwan: the island fills the centre of the frame with bright golden city lights along its west coast, the sun rising behind the curved horizon at the top with a brilliant orange glow lighting the sea. A tight ring of dozens of large, bright orange-red glowing warships encircles the island on the sea, joined by glowing orange lines into a blockade cordon; the coast of mainland China glows at the left edge.

Night photo on a rocky coastline: a large road-mobile ballistic missile launching from its multi-axle launcher truck, the missile rising diagonally to the upper right over the dark sea, an enormous bright orange and white rocket flame and billowing glowing smoke lighting the rocks, the truck and the waves.
